headline: Omega Infergon
title: Omega Infergon | Break It To Win | Aniimo Boss Guide
video_script: Omega Infergon in Russet Highlands is a Fire boss, and Water is the best counter. First finish the Warrior Journey quest to unlock it. Then shatter its Fire crystals before they explode, because they release a shock wave. Its Ultimate shows a casting warning, so push it into Break before the attack finishes. Once it is broken it takes much more damage. Did you beat it? Comment below!
description: Omega Infergon boss tips: Russet Highlands, Fire boss countered by Water, shatter fire crystallites, Break it to interrupt its Ultimate. Checked Nov 2026.
